issue.author: paper-repo
issue.body:
I own report/report.md (one page). The analysis (download + hashing) is yours; I need its results to write the report. Please push to experiment-repo a machine-readable results file (e.g. results/files.csv + results/env.json) containing:

1. For EVERY file in the repo (including .gitattributes, README.md, config.json, vocabulary, tokenizer.json, model.bin etc.): path, size in bytes, locally computed SHA-256, the SHA-256 the HF API reports (e.g. model_info(..., files_metadata=True) siblings' lfs.sha256 / blob_id for non-LFS files — say which kind of hash the API gives for non-LFS files, since git blob ids are SHA-1, not SHA-256), and a match flag. Say how non-LFS files were checked if the API gives no SHA-256.
2. Installed huggingface_hub and hf_xet versions (default install, HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET unset), the revision/commit SHA of the repo downloaded, and evidence on whether the download actually went through Xet (e.g. logs/ cache xet dir/ HF_XET debug output), not just that hf_xet is installed.
3. The commands/script used and its log.

Also: please settle the work assignment (assignment.json) naming me as provider of report/report.md, and the figure/table (no figure is needed; the table lives in the report) split. Waiting on this: the whole report. I will cite file paths and your commit.
issue.title: Results file for Systran/faster-whisper-tiny: per-file size, SHA-256, API SHA-256, versions, Xet evidence

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
How big are the files of the smallest faster-whisper model, and what are their checksums?

Download the Hugging Face model repository `Systran/faster-whisper-tiny` with the `huggingface_hub` Python package as it installs by default (keep its Xet transfer on: do not set `HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET`). Record, for every file in the repository, its size in bytes and its SHA-256, and check each SHA-256 against the one the Hugging Face API reports for that file. Record the installed versions of `huggingface_hub` and `hf_xet`, and whether the download went through Xet.

Report: `report/report.md`, one page with the table of files, sizes and checksums, whether every checksum matched, and the package versions.

issue.author: experiment-repo
issue.body:
Measurements are pushed in world/experiment-repo at 3a4db174bcf32de0cccdc6de161ae47b4f0c8190: results/files.csv (per-file size, SHA-256, API values), results/summary.json, results/provenance.md (read it for caveats). Per assignment.json you write report/report.md (one page): table of 6 files (name, bytes, SHA-256), match status, versions (huggingface_hub 2.2.0, hf_xet 1.7.0), Xet use.

Key findings, stated precisely: (1) Only model.bin (75,538,270 B) is LFS/Xet-backed, and its local SHA-256 dcb76c65…e6d1 matches the API's lfs.sha256. (2) The other 5 files have NO API SHA-256 (API gives only git blob SHA-1); so 'every checksum matched' must be qualified: 1 of 1 API-reported SHA-256 matched; the 5 others verified only via git blob SHA-1 == API blob_id (all match), which is not a SHA-256 comparison. (3) Xet was on; only model.bin went through Xet (log + xet hash from HEAD); the other 5 via plain HTTP. Revision d90ca5fe260221311c53c58e660288d3deb8d356. Use full 64-hex SHA-256s from files.csv in the table. Ask me if anything is missing.
